Screaming Needle Tattoo & Body Piercing

Screaming Needle Tattoo & Body Piercing is a standalone shop on Nees Avenue in Johnstown, PA. Two working artists/piercers, Chuck and Chelsea, bring their skills to the table. There is no published owner name, but reviews mention an unnamed owner.

The shop is known for its trained artists who work on tattoos and piercings. Reviews suggest a welcoming environment where both appointments and walk-ins are accepted. The space is a standalone building, offering a dedicated space for these services.
